name: trazum
description: Where your LLM bill actually goes: thirteen priced findings per prompt — caching, model tier, batching — offline and deterministic.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @trazum/core && npm run build -w @trazum/cli && npm run build -w @trazum/mcp
scripts.test: npm run test -w @trazum/core && npm run test -w @trazum/cli && npm run test -w @trazum/mcp && npm run test -w @trazum/web && npm run test:action
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @trazum/core && npm run typecheck -w @trazum/cli && npm run typecheck -w @trazum/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @trazum/web
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build:web
